info.title: PaperGo headless DMS
info.description: One organization per SQLite deployment. Immutable schema/content revisions, SharePoint-style exclusive permission scopes, head/published projections, rich typed fields, reusable templates, saved queries, personal/shared smart folders with cross-collection navigation and classification, taxonomy, and typed relationships. Libraries with webdav_enabled are also served over WebDAV (RFC 4918 class 1 and 2) at /webdav/{libraryID}/, outside this contract; WebDAV accepts these bearer tokens or HTTP Basic with a WebDAV credential password. Workflows (triggers, a condition and a flow of activities, with built-in workflows people can turn on, configure or copy) react to committed item changes, schedules and manual starts; runs are durable and are listed under each workspace. Organization groups support nested membership; persisted roles grant module scopes independently of resource ACLs. Verified subjects enroll with the Member role on first authentication. ADMIN_SUBJECT provisions the first administrator once; development defaults to DEV_SUBJECT.

delete.summary: Delete a resource, optionally including folder contents
delete.description: Deletes an item or empty folder with write access and the current If-Match. For a folder, recursive=true deletes the folder and all live descendants atomically, requiring write access to every descendant. Without recursive=true, any live child, including a hidden item or nested folder, returns 409 with code folder_not_empty. Deleted children do not prevent ordinary deletion. Permission failures and stale versions leave the entire tree unchanged. Workspace and collection deletion require manage access and remove the entire live resource tree independently of recursive; collection managers may delete the entire collection regardless of descendant ACLs. Tombstones, revisions and audit history are retained. Read projections and live relationships are removed, and each deleted item emits item.deleted. Workflows bound to a deleted workspace or collection are disabled and deleted.

Self, deleted items, historical files and inaccessible content do not count. Requires list.write and document.write and item write access with current If-Match. Last-Event-ID resumes retained positions for seven days; expired positions return 410. connected and resync instruct clients to use durable delta links for complete deletion/access reconciliation.
